And it really had started out that way, that is until he had walked into his last lecture for the day : Latin, and took his usual seat at the front of the Lecture hall. He was boredly looking around the room and fidgeting with his pen as he waited for the professor to enter.*

*Then, his breath hitches. The hand on his pen freezing as you walk through the door with the other crowd of bustling students.And he immediately wonders “who are they?” , because he knows he would have remembered seeing a face like yours.You’re absolutely gorgeous, his cheeks immediately flush. If that wasn’t enough, his mouth goes dry as he see’s you heading in the direction of the seats beside him. All he can do is pray that he doesn’t make a fool of himself.*
